liam: quick follow-up from the aggregation-drift postmortem (link: https://rwd/internal/postmortems/aggregation-drift-2025). proposing a 10-day remediation sprint focused on three areas: ETL lag/backfill, aggregator cardinality regression, and sampling-test coverage + alerts. owners and rough dates below, pls ack and flag blockers. :clipboard:

keiko: ack — i'll own the aggregator cardinality fix. initial findings: the dedupe switch to left_join reduced group membership when sampling flag was set. repro query (very small):```sql
-- repro: missing traces when sampling enabled
select service, count(distinct trace_id) as unique_traces
from spans_processed s
left join dedupe_meta d on s.span_id = d.span_id
where s.ts >= '{{start}}'
group by service;
```
Plan: patch join logic to preserve grouping for sampled records, add unit+integration tests, then 12h canary on prod read-only mirror. target PR by 2025-11-05.

oliver: i'll take ETL lag root cause + backfill orchestration. triage today (2d), fix + deploy (3d), backfill (region-by-region, rate-limited) over 2 days. tentative done by 2025-11-09. backfill command will run with controlled concurrency, e.g.:```bash
BACKFILL_WINDOW='2025-10-20_2025-10-27'
./scripts/run_backfill.sh --region us-west-2 --concurrency 4 --dry-run
```
I'll coordinate with infra to reserve slot and with oncall to mute noisy alerts. need a safety check for idempotency before running live backfill.

nina: i'll own sampling integration tests and alerting. plan: create a nightly synthetic-run that asserts invariants: total_traces_raw == total_traces_processed +-1%. add an alert (warning then critical) on deviation. also will add a test to ensure alerts can be muted programmatically during controlled backfills and auto-resume. target 2025-11-06.

ava: runbook / recurrence ownership here. i'll draft a postmortem-runbook entry with rollback steps, pager thresholds, and a monthly "aggregation health" job that verifies pipeline parity and surfaces drift. will include playbook steps for region-by-region backfill. target 2025-11-08.

proc-bot: created TASK-60880 (etl-lag-orchestration), TASK-60881 (aggregator-cardinality-fix), TASK-60882 (sampling-tests-alerts), TASK-60883 (aggregation-health-job).

liam: sensible. couple of constraints: 1) infra has limited backfill GPU slots next week (oliver, coordinate with infra ASAP). 2) oncall prefers backfills in low-traffic windows (us-west overnight). please list specific mute windows in PR description. 3) link each PR to the postmortem and add a one-line rollback plan (how to revert canary). i'll run a 20min sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to unblock infra and confirm dates. thanks. :rocket:
